paper_title: A Universal Bound on QCD Axions from Supernovae
coupling_convention: x = f_a in GeV, y = m_a in eV (bound: f_a > 1.1e8 GeV, equivalently m_a < 5.3e-2 eV)
notes: Astrophysical (SN1987A cooling) bound directly on the f_a-m_a plane (Fig. 5 shows 1/fa vs ma), so AxionMass is the correct type. Model-independent bound from a new tree-level axion production channel via the isospin-breaking c5 operator: fa > 1.1(+0.4/-0.6)x10^8 GeV, ma < 5.3(+7.3/-1.3)x10^-2 eV. IMPORTANT: the paper quotes 68% C.L., not 90/95% - the schema-required confidence_level of 0.90 does not reflect the paper's actual 68% statement. No DM density assumption (not a haloscope; explicitly does not require axion to be dark matter). The bound is a single point on the QCD axion line rather than a curve.
